SENATORS BY DISTRICT

In the primary and general elections of 2022, Maryland voters cast their votes in legislative districts laid out in the Legislative Districting Plan of 2022. Legislators elected in the 2022 General Election took office on January 11, 2023, and serve until January 13, 2027.

Miller Senate Office Building, 11 Bladen St., Annapolis, Maryland, January 2001. Photo by Diane F. Evartt.
